links.outcome: Performance drop from internal to external cohort for late-AMD detection and progression
links.effect: Prevalent late-AMD AUROC 0.984 internally vs 0.975 externally; five-year progression AUROC 0.825 vs 0.767.
links.quote: ORBIT-AMD achieved AUROC values of 0.984 internally and 0.975 externally for prevalent late-AMD detection.

links.outcome: Cohort dependence of calibration, thresholds and workload across sites
links.effect: Calibration and threshold analyses showed cohort-dependent workload and absolute-risk behavior, supporting site-specific calibration assessment before deployment.
links.quote: Calibration and threshold analyses showed cohort-dependent workload and absolute-risk behavior, supporting site-specific calibration assessment and clinical-workflow evaluation before deployment.

unlisted_practices: Concept-bottleneck lesion-level explanations for imaging risk models
Bilateral eye-graph attention and ordinal staging architecture for AMD risk

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal trajectory-learning AI model on retrospective cohorts (UK Biobank and external clinical cohort) for AMD staging and progression prediction, including calibration and threshold analysis, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice.
